title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-20
lineage: SBD > MR > ? > FM > ? > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Historic 12/20/69 show with the first New Speedway Boogie and a wild Lovelight, captured on a soundboard that suffers from tape hiss and occasional skips.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that sounds decent overall but is marred by tape hiss, CD‑skip artifacts on "China Cat" and some rough edges. Musically the show is a mixed bag – early versions of "New Speedway Boogie", an incendiary "Lovelight" rap, and solid China Cat > Rider jams are praised, while performances like "High Time" and "Hard to Handle" are seen as uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is historically significant with several standout moments, but recording flaws and uneven performance pull the overall score down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape hiss between songs, occasional CD‑skip on "China Cat", roughness around "High Time" and some dropouts; overall listenable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early acoustic transition with a solid first set (45 min) and a longer, more exploratory second set; historic but uneven performance.
